Set up broader phylogeny to test placement of newarkensis

Trying: sampled_nwrk_ids see 102.2 for generation of m181.csv

```{r}
m181<-read_csv("metadata/m181.csv") %>% relocate(Species, Vicinity,`Tributary/Collection Location`,GVL_Code)

m181 %>% group_by(Species) %>% summarize(Count=n())

m181 %>% select(Path) %>% write_tsv("bamlists/181.bamlist", col_names = FALSE)
m181 %>% select(GVL_Code) %>% write_tsv("bamlists/181.names", col_names = FALSE)

```

Test commands to generate MAF filtered file and a pruned file based on random SNP sampling

```{sh, eval=FALSE}
module load bcftools

srun -p bmh -t 1:00:00 --mem=128GB --cpus-per-task=12 bash -c '
 angsd -nthreads 12 \
-minInd 163 -bam bamlists/181.bamlist -out outputs/102/snps-05 \
-ref /home/jsweeney/genomes/genome.fasta -r JBECYN010000001.1:1-1000000 \
-minMaf 0.05 -minMapQ 20 -minQ 20 -GL 1 -doMajorMinor 1 -doMaf 1 -SNP_pval 1e-6 \
-doGeno 2 -doPost 1 -postCutoff 0.95 -doPlink 2 \
> outputs/102/snps-05.out 2> outputs/102/snps-05.err 

plink --tfile outputs/102/snps-05 --recode vcf bgz --out outputs/102/snps-05-recode --keep-allele-order --allow-extra-chr

bcftools reheader --samples bamlists/181.names outputs/102/snps-05-recode.vcf.gz | bcftools +fill-tags -Ou -- -t MAF,F_MISSING | bcftools view -i "F_MISSING < 0.10 && MAF > 0.10" -Oz -o  outputs/102/snps-10-renamed.vcf.gz

bcftools +prune -n 1 -N rand --random-seed 123 -w 50000bp \
  outputs/102/snps-10-renamed.vcf.gz -Oz -o outputs/102/snps-pruned-10.vcf.gz
  
bcftools reheader --samples bamlists/181.names outputs/102/snps-05-recode.vcf.gz | bcftools +fill-tags -Ou -- -t MAF,F_MISSING | bcftools view -i "F_MISSING < 0.10 && MAF > 0.05" -Oz -o  outputs/102/snps-05-renamed.vcf.gz

bcftools +prune -n 1 -N rand --random-seed 123 -w 50000bp \
  outputs/102/snps-05-renamed.vcf.gz -Oz -o outputs/102/snps-pruned-05.vcf.gz
'
```

```{sh, eval=FALSE}

#1 checking missingness at an individual level
bcftools stats -s - snps-pruned-10.vcf.gz | awk '
  /^PSC/ {
    # Column 3: Sample name
    # Column 4: nRefHom, Column 5: nNonRefHom, Column 6: nHets, Column 14: nMissing
    called = $4 + $5 + $6
    missing = $14
    total = called + missing
    if (total > 0 && (missing / total) > 0.10) {
      print $3
    }
  }
' > missing10.txt

bcftools view -S ^missing10.txt snps-pruned-10.vcf.gz -Oz -o snps-pruned-10-drop.vcf.gz

bcftools stats -s - snps-pruned-05.vcf.gz | awk '
  /^PSC/ {
    # Column 3: Sample name
    # Column 4: nRefHom, Column 5: nNonRefHom, Column 6: nHets, Column 14: nMissing
    called = $4 + $5 + $6
    missing = $14
    total = called + missing
    if (total > 0 && (missing / total) > 0.10) {
      print $3
    }
  }
' > missing10-snps05.txt

bcftools view -S ^missing10-snps05.txt snps-pruned-05.vcf.gz -Oz -o snps-pruned-05-drop.vcf.gz


conda activate py2
~/github/mccloud-rrt/vcf2phylip.py -i snps-pruned-10.vcf.gz

#compare resulting phylogenies
iqtree2  -nt AUTO -m MFP+ASC -bb 1000 -s snps-pruned-10.min4.phy --seqtype DNA --redo
iqtree2  -nt AUTO -m MFP+ASC -bb 10000 -s snps-pruned-10.min4.phy.varsites.phy --seqtype DNA --redo
